      Starting a Community Book Club

      Learn how to start a community book club.

      Tch Laureate, Genevieve Debose Akinnagbe, shares ten steps for starting a community book club. Her tips include how to secure the books, how long students are permitted to read the book, and fun ideas for the actual book club meeting. This is the second video in the Tch DIY series on Project LIT Bronx.
